title: Three RCP Strategies Earn High Rankings from PitchBook
summary: RCP Advisors, a Ridgepost Capital strategy, earned high rankings from PitchBook across its small and emerging manager, secondary, and co-investment strategies, reflecting the firm's long-standing focus on the lower-middle market and disciplined investment approach.
